scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplies all-distance uniqueness. Standalone code is numerical corroboration only; existing formulas are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous half-line coherent walk with one Lindblad boundary sink and a single-site initial state initial site at least two.
The closed absorption quadrature is an existing input; the new uniqueness, reciprocal bias and large-distance asymptotics are analytically derived consequences.
Does not address finite-time absorption, mean first absorption time, boundary-start m=1, disorder, multiple sinks or finite chains.
Published-literature priority is best-knowledge; no independent audit was performed.
title: Unique strong-side absorption optimum for a half-line quantum walk
